gemma_target_scope: language model only; vision/projector parameters frozen

budget.note: Runtime guards and finite invocations constrain spend; these estimates are not a provider-enforced dollar billing cap. No automatic retry campaign is authorized.

protocol_notes: Document-only intervention pilot: one complete pass of the 2,000 articles per framing, without background mixing or correctness/confidence supervision.
Rank, alpha, learning rate, and effective batch size follow the existing local document-training configuration.
Cloud runner supports both requested model architectures; the old local runner only supports the local Qwen checkpoint and a separate background-mixed recipe.
All conditions start from the same immutable base revision. Each run creates a fresh adapter and optimizer.

Document counts, data order per seed, epochs, and optimizer settings are matched. Actual tokenizer-specific token exposures are reported rather than silently truncated or padded into artificial training examples.
The larger sequence ceiling is only a rejection guard; batches pad to their longest real example and all padding labels are masked.
No benchmark evaluation, answer generation, or calibration training is included.
